corrections.reason: The printed glyph at the end of line 24 is clearly ት (ሁከት, 'sedition/tumult', matching Luke 23:25 and line 26 ሁከት), which was misread as ክ.
Plural verb ending ሡ ('as they desired/sought', matching ፈቃዶሙ) has the 2nd-order stroke on the right leg of the final ሠ.
Classical Ge'ez verbal noun/infinitive አትውቶ ('his coming in' from ሐቅል 'the country', Luke 23:26); the printed characters are clearly አ-ት-ው-ቶ, not እ-ን-ው-ቶ, and እምሐቅል wraps across L36-L37.
